# Macro & Meals

> Macro & Meals (https://macroandmeals.com) provides free nutrition calculators and health tools for 50+ restaurants, BMI, BMR, TDEE, macros, vitamins, and more. All tools are free, no login required.

Macro & Meals helps users make informed dietary decisions with accurate nutrition data from popular restaurant chains and science-backed health calculators. The site covers restaurant nutrition analysis with meal builders, body composition calculators, macro and calorie tracking tools, vitamin intake guides, and pregnancy/fertility tools.

## Health & Fitness Calculators

- [ABSI Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/absi-calculator/): Calculate your A Body Shape Index (ABSI) to assess health risk based on waist circumference relative to BMI and height.
- [Anorexic BMI Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/anorexic-bmi-calculator/): Understand BMI ranges associated with anorexia nervosa and when to seek help.
- [Army Body Fat Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/army-body-fat-calculator/): Calculate body fat percentage using the U.S. Army method (AR 600-9) with tape measurements.
- [BMI Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bmi-calculator/): Calculate your Body Mass Index, body fat estimate, ideal weight, and get a complete health profile — all in one tool.
- [BMI NIH Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bmi-nih-calculator/): Calculate BMI using the NIH (National Institutes of Health) classification system with disease risk assessment.
- [BMR Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bmr-calculator/): Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate using multiple scientific formulas. Find out how many calories your body burns at re
- [BRI Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bri-calculator/): Calculate your Body Roundness Index to assess body shape and health risk from abdominal fat.
- [BSA Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bsa-calculator/): Calculate your Body Surface Area using multiple medical formulas (Du Bois, Mosteller, Haycock).
- [Baby Percentile Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/baby-percentile-calculator/): Track your baby's growth against WHO growth charts. See weight, length, and head circumference percentiles.
- [Bedridden Patient Height Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/bedridden-patient-height-calculator/): Estimate height for bedridden patients using knee height, arm span, or ulna length measurements.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/body-fat-calculator/): Estimate your body fat percentage using the U.S. Navy method. Get lean mass, fat mass, and fitness category.
- [Body Shape Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/body-shape-calculator/): Determine your body shape type (apple, pear, hourglass, rectangle, inverted triangle) from measurements.
- [Calorie Deficit Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/calorie-deficit-calculator/): Plan your calorie deficit for safe, sustainable weight loss. Get personalized targets with macro breakdowns and timeline
- [Carbohydrate Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/carbohydrate-calculator/): Determine your optimal daily carbohydrate intake based on activity level, goals, and metabolic needs.
- [Cholesterol Ratio Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/cholesterol-ratio-calculator/): Calculate your cholesterol ratios to assess cardiovascular risk using total, HDL, and LDL values.
- [Conception Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/conception-calculator/): Estimate when conception likely occurred based on your due date or last menstrual period.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/due-date-calculator/): Calculate your estimated due date based on your last menstrual period or conception date.
- [FFMI Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/ffmi-calculator/): Calculate your Fat-Free Mass Index to assess your muscular development relative to height.
- [Face Shape Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/face-shape-calculator/): Determine your face shape (oval, round, square, heart, oblong) from facial measurements.
- [GFR Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/gfr-calculator/): Estimate your Glomerular Filtration Rate to assess kidney function using the CKD-EPI equation.
- [Height Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/height-calculator/): Predict adult height based on current age, parental heights, and growth data.
- [IVF Success Rate Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/ivf-success-rate-calculator/): Estimate your IVF success probability based on age, diagnosis, and treatment factors.
- [Ideal Body Weight Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/ideal-body-weight-calculator/): Calculate your ideal body weight using multiple medical formulas (Devine, Hamwi, Robinson, Miller).
- [Karvonen Formula Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/karvonen-formula-calculator/): Calculate your target heart rate zones for exercise using the Karvonen method with heart rate reserve.
- [Keto Macro Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/keto-macro-calculator/): Get precise macronutrient targets for the ketogenic diet based on your body composition and goals.
- [LDL Cholesterol Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/ldl-cholesterol-calculator/): Estimate your LDL cholesterol using the Friedewald equation from total cholesterol, HDL, and triglycerides.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Estimate your lean body mass (fat-free weight) using multiple scientifically validated formulas.
- [Maintenance Fluid Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/maintenance-fluid-calculator/): Calculate daily IV fluid requirements using the Holliday-Segar formula for pediatric and adult patients.
- [Menses Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/menses-calculator/): Track and predict your menstrual cycle, including period dates, fertile windows, and cycle regularity.
- [One Rep Max Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/one-rep-max-calculator/): Calculate your one-rep max (1RM) for any exercise using multiple proven formulas.
- [Overweight Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/overweight-calculator/): Determine if you are overweight and assess associated health risks using BMI and waist measurements.
- [Ovulation Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/ovulation-calculator/): Predict your most fertile days and ovulation date based on your menstrual cycle.
- [Pregnancy Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/pregnancy-calculator/): Track your pregnancy week by week. Get due date, trimester info, baby size estimates, and important milestones.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator/): Track recommended weight gain during pregnancy based on your pre-pregnancy BMI and current week.
- [Protein Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/protein-calculator/): Determine your optimal daily protein intake based on body weight, activity level, and fitness goals.
- [Protein Molecular Weight Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/protein-molecular-weight-calculator/): Calculate the molecular weight of a protein from its amino acid sequence or number of amino acids.
- [Raising Cane's Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/raising-canes-calculator/): Check calories and macros for chicken fingers and combos.
- [Skinfold Body Fat Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/skinfold-body-fat-calculator/): Estimate body fat percentage from skinfold caliper measurements using the Jackson-Pollock method.
- [Steps to Miles Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/steps-to-miles-calculator/): Convert your step count to distance in miles and kilometers using your height for accurate stride length.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/tdee-calculator/): Find out exactly how many calories you burn every day. Get personalized macro targets for weight loss, maintenance, or m
- [US Marine Body Fat Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/us-marine-body-fat-calculator/): Calculate body fat using the U.S. Marine Corps method (NAVPERS) with circumference measurements.
- [Vitamin A Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-a-calculator/): Calculate your recommended daily vitamin A intake based on age, gender, pregnancy status, and health factors.
- [Vitamin B Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-b-calculator/): Calculate your daily needs for all 8 B vitamins. Get personalized recommendations based on age, diet, and lifestyle.
- [Vitamin C Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-c-calculator/): Determine your optimal daily vitamin C intake based on age, smoking status, health conditions, and stress levels.
- [Vitamin D Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-d-calculator/): Get a personalized vitamin D dosage based on your health profile, current levels, sun exposure, and risk factors.
- [Vitamin E Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-e-calculator/): Calculate your recommended vitamin E intake based on age, gender, and health conditions.
- [Vitamin K Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/vitamin-k-calculator/): Determine your vitamin K requirements for bone health, blood clotting, and cardiovascular protection.
- [Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator/): Calculate your waist-to-hip ratio to assess abdominal fat distribution and related health risks.
- [Water Fasting Calculator](https://macroandmeals.com/water-fasting-calculator/): Estimate calorie burn, weight loss, and safety guidelines for water fasting periods.
- [kJ to Calories Converter](https://macroandmeals.com/kj-to-calories-converter/): Convert between kilojoules and calories instantly. Useful for reading nutrition labels from different countries.
